I am an Associate Professor in the [Department of Political and Social Sciences](https://www.dsps.unifi.it/) at the [University of Florence](https://www.unifi.it/).

My research focuses on comparative political institutions, with particular attention to parliamentary agenda-setting, coalition governance, crisis politics, and the interplay between national and European decision-making. I also teach [Introduction to Political Science and European Union Politics](https://unifi.coursecatalogue.cineca.it/docente-id/6a022368e2b963582449eab6/2025) at undergraduate and graduate level.

You can browse publications by type on the [Research](/publication/research.html) page and find current collaborations on the [Projects](/projects/projects.html) page.

::: home-section
## Current projects

- Co-founder and co-PI of the [Italian Policy Agendas Project](https://www.comparativeagendas.net/project/italy) and the [Portuguese Policy Agendas Project](https://www.comparativeagendas.net/project/portugal)

- Member of the Board of Directors of [MEDEM - Monitoring Electoral Democracy](https://medem.eu) and Scientific Coordinator of the MEDEM Service Center for Country and Institutional Data at DSPS

## Recent projects

- Jean Monnet Module - [Implementing Resilience and Recovery Plans in Italy and beyond](https://www.dsps.unifi.it/p577.html)

- PRIN project - [Explaining the formulation and implementation of Recovery and Resilience Plans in Europe: a comparative approach](https://www.replaneuresearch.eu/home-page)
:::
